PAGE_ANALYTICS_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCR: The website analytics feature provides the user with the ability to evaluate visitor activity on the site through charts based on three main criteria: views, visits, and sessions. The charts display the dynamics of these indicators over a certain period of time, which allows analyzing the effectiveness of the site's content and marketing activities.

The analytics page also presents tables showing the number of views of entries and static pages. These tables allow for a more detailed study of which specific materials attract more user attention and which site pages are the most popular. Such analysis helps optimize content and increase its appeal to visitors.

Using website analytics data, resource owners can make informed decisions to improve user experience, increase conversion, and enhance the overall effectiveness of the site. Analytics helps identify the successes and weaknesses of the site, as well as evaluate the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, which allows optimizing the development strategy and achieving the set goals.

PAGE_INDEX_STEP_ANALYTIC_DESCRIPTION: The company »Karelian Developer» has prepared a tool for analyzing data on the site and content. Monitor indicators directly in the administrative panel!

PAGE_ENTRIES_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCRIP: Entries — are the main unit of content that contains information about a specific topic or event. Websites consist of various entries, such as articles, news, product pages, and so on.

Entries play an important role for a website, as they contain information that attracts visitors and makes the site interesting and relevant. Publishing new entries helps increase site traffic, improve its search engine optimization, and maintain interaction with the audience.
Thus, entries in a content management system are the foundation of a website, and their creation and updating play an important role in the successful operation of the site.
PAGE_ENTRIES_CATEGORIES_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_AB: Entry categories are a way of organizing content on a website in a content management system such as WordPress. They allow grouping entries by certain topics or categories, which makes site navigation more convenient for users.

Entry categories are important for a website because they help organize content and make it more accessible to visitors. In addition, using categories helps improve the site's SEO optimization, as search engines can better understand the structure and subject matter of the content.
Thus, entry categories play an important role in managing content on a website, helping to improve user experience and increase the site's visibility in search results.

PAGE_ENTRIES_COMMENTS_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOU: Entry comments are a feature that allows users to leave their comments and reviews under published entries on the website. This feature allows creating interactive interaction between the content author and site visitors, as well as between the visitors themselves.

Entry comments are important for a website because they contribute to increasing audience engagement, discussing the topic, and increasing user activity on the site. In addition, comments can be useful for getting feedback from users, their opinions, ideas, and suggestions.
Thus, this feature is an important tool for creating an interactive and lively community on the website, as well as for improving the quality of content and interaction with the audience.

PAGE_ENTRY_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCRIPTI: Entries — are the main unit of content that contains information about a specific topic or event. Websites consist of various entries, such as articles, news, product pages, and so on.

Entries play an important role for a website, as they contain information that attracts visitors and makes the site interesting and relevant. Publishing new entries helps increase site traffic, improve its search engine optimization, and maintain interaction with the audience.
Thus, entries in a content management system are the foundation of a website, and their creation and updating play an important role in the successful operation of the site.
PAGE_ENTRY_CATEGORIES_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOU: An entry category in a content management system (CMS) is a way of organizing and classifying content on a website. It allows grouping entries, articles, or other types of content by certain topics or characteristics. For example, on a news site, you can create categories such as "Politics", "Sports", "Culture", which simplifies navigation and information search for users.

It is important to note that categories help improve the site structure and make it more convenient for visitors. When content is properly organized by categories, users can find the information they are interested in faster, which increases the overall level of satisfaction from using the site. In addition, having clear categories contributes to a better perception of the site as a professional and structured resource.

From an SEO (search engine optimization) perspective, categories also play an important role. They help search engines better index content, which can lead to improved positions in search results. Proper use of categories can increase site visibility and attract more targeted traffic, which in turn contributes to audience growth and increased conversion.
PAGE_MEDIA_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCRIPTI: Media files in a content management system are files that contain multimedia content, such as images or videos. They are used for the visual design of the site, illustrating content, as well as creating a more attractive and interactive user environment.

Media files play an important role for a website as a whole, as they help improve user experience, making it more attractive and informative. In addition, the use of high-quality media files can improve the site's SEO optimization and improve its positions in search results.
Thus, proper management and use of media files in a content management system helps create an effective and attractive website that will attract more visitors and improve user experience.
PAGE_MODULE_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCRIPT: Modules are independent components designed to add various functionalities to a website. They can include elements such as sliders, feedback forms, carousels, image galleries, and much more.

Modules are important for a website because they provide its functionality and improve user experience. In addition, modules allow you to easily extend the site's capabilities without requiring additional development. Thanks to modules, site administrators can easily manage content, add new features, and update information, making the site more attractive and convenient for visitors.

PAGE_STATIC_PAGES_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DE: A static page — is a web page whose content remains unchanged and does not depend on user actions.

Static pages are important for a website because they can load quickly and ensure stable content display. They can also be used to create the main pages of the site, such as "About Us", "Contacts", "Services", which helps users easily find information about the company or products. It is important to consider that static pages can be used in combination with dynamic elements to create a more interactive user experience.

PAGE_THEME_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCRIPTI: Themes are pre-created structures that define the appearance and design of website pages. They include design elements, block layout, fonts, colors, and other stylistic parameters.

Themes are important for a website because they provide a uniform and professional appearance of pages. Thanks to templates, you can easily create new pages without spending time on creating a design from scratch. They also facilitate updating and changing the site design, as changes in the template are automatically applied to all pages using this template. As a result, templates help improve user experience, making the site more attractive and convenient for visitors.

Users are important for a website because they can participate in creating and updating content, share information and opinions, and create a community around the site. They can also participate in feedback and communication with site administrators, which helps improve user experience and content quality. PAGE_USERS_GROUP_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DES: User groups are a functionality in a content management system that allows site administrators to combine users into certain categories or groups based on their characteristics or access rights. This allows managing access to various sections of the site, controlling user rights, managing mailings and notifications, and conducting personalized promotions and offers for certain user groups.

User groups are important for a website because they provide more convenient and efficient management of users and content. They allow creating a personalized experience for users, improving site security, managing access to confidential information, and ensuring more effective interaction with the audience. Overall, user groups help optimize the site's operation and increase its functionality.

PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_TITLE_DESCRIP: The site name serves as an important attribute for searching on the Internet, so name the site in such a way that it reflects the essence of its content.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_TIMEZONE_DESC: The time zone will help track events on the site relative to the selected time zone. Otherwise, the server's time zone will be used.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_CHARSET_DESCR: Configuring the site encoding will allow you to correctly display the content of web pages. Currently, the most common encoding is «UTF-8» — we recommend using it.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_LOCALE_SITE_D: Localization will allow you to translate the site into a language understandable for your site's users.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_LOCALE_ADMIN_: Localization will allow you to translate the CMS into a language understandable for you.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_ENGINEERING_W: If you need to perform maintenance work on the site, enable it, after which a special stub page will be displayed instead of the site.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_ENTRI: The «Entries» section is a set of tools that allows you to perform manipulations with entries on the site as well as their categories. We recommend enabling this section for news, corporate, and blog-type sites.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_STATI: The «Static pages» section is a set of tools that allows you to perform manipulations with static pages on the site. It is recommended to use it always, except for landing pages (selling pages).
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_MODUL: The «Modules» section allows you to extend the functionality of the «GIRVAS» content management system by integrating additional functionality into the site or the administrative control panel.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_THEME: The «Templates» section allows you to manage the appearance (shell) of the site and the administrative control panel.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_USERS: The «Users» section is necessary if you want someone other than you to be able to do something on the site, for example, registered users. Please note that if this section is disabled, you will not be able to change the credentials of previously created users, except your own.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_MEDIA: The «Media files» section allows you to work with the media component of your site. Here, for example, you can manage uploaded images or upload new ones. In the future, it will also be possible to upload videos.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_FEEDS: The «Feeds» section is necessary for improving indexing by search engines as well as for the ability to import content from your site to other platforms. If your site is a landing page (selling page), then you do not need this section.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_BASE_SECTION_ANALY: The «Analytics» section is a statistical section where you can analyze the situation around the content on your site. For example, you can see how many views entries or static pages have, as well as how many times users visited your site during the day.

PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SECURITY_FILTER_RE: The email address filter will help filter out unwanted registrations from various email addresses. The system will not allow registration for users who try to create an account through email services that are NOT included in this list.

Pre-moderation of comments with external links

PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_CONTENT_SECURITY_P: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an additional security layer that allows detecting and mitigating certain types of attacks, such as Cross Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks. The scope of these attacks includes, but is not limited to, data theft, page substitution, and malware distribution. [About the technology]
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SEO_SITE_DESCRIPTI: The site description should accurately reflect the essence of its content and also include keywords.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SEO_KEYWORDS_DESCR: Keywords should help find the site in search engines. To select keywords, we recommend using services such as «Yandex Wordstat» and «Google Trends».
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SEO_INPUT_KEYWORDS: Girvas volcano, Republic of Karelia, Fishing in Nadvoitsy village
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SEO_ROBOTS_TXT_DES: Robots.txt — is a text file that contains site indexing parameters for search engine robots. In robots.txt, you can restrict search engine robots from indexing site pages, which can reduce the load on the site and speed up its operation. [More details]
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SEO_LLMS_TXT_DESCR: LLMS.txt — is a text file in Markdown format. It is designed to help large language models (LLM) and AI assistants understand the structure and content of the site, as well as interpret its content.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SEO_CODE_YANDEX_WE: This code is used to confirm rights to the site in the «Yandex: Webmaster» service.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_SEO_PERMANENT_REDI: Forced redirect to a subdomain can help with site optimization for search engine robots if you need to consider the WWW subdomain as the main address of your site. For example, if you use the webmaster tool service in «Yandex», this will be useful for implementing the site's move to the WWW subdomain as the main address.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_UPLOAD_AVATA: Enable the avatar upload parameter by users if necessary. If you plan to prohibit this for your users or will use avatar generators in the future, disable this parameter. Please note that restrictions on avatar uploads are specified in the "Files" subsection of this section.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_LOGIN_LENGTH: This parameter allows you to limit the maximum number of characters in a user login. We recommend using no more than 16 characters. If no restrictions are required, specify 0.

This parameter allows you to limit the minimum number of characters in a user login. We recommend using at least 6 characters. Please note that the parameter value cannot be set below 4, as this is a limitation of the system by the developers.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_LOGIN_EDIT_D: If you do not want users to be able to edit their login after registering on the site, disable this parameter. Otherwise, users will be able to do this, even if you restrict editing of the login field in the user profile settings.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_LOGIN_SPECIA: Enable this parameter if you want to allow the use of special characters in user logins. Special characters: !@#$%&
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_PASSWORD_LEN: This parameter allows you to limit the maximum number of characters in a user password. We recommend using no more than 24 characters. If no restrictions are required, specify 0.

This parameter allows you to limit the minimum number of characters in a user password. We recommend using at least 8 characters. Please note that the parameter value cannot be set below 6, as this is a limitation of the system by the developers.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_PASSWORD_SPE: Enable this parameter if you want to allow the use of special characters in user passwords. Special characters: !@#$%&
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_LOGINS_BLACK: Login filtering allows you to prohibit the use of certain logins in the system. Enable this parameter, and in that case, all logins specified in the login list field will be prohibited during user registration and editing.

Please note that all logins specified in this field will be blacklisted and will not be allowed for registration, and existing users will not be able to specify them when editing their profiles. Specify logins separated by commas. We recommend adding: admin, administrator, moder, moderator, cms, cmsgirvas, girvas, system, gov
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_USERS_LOGIN_REGIST: Enable this parameter if you need the system to be case-sensitive for user logins during registration. Please note that if this parameter is enabled, the logins "username" and "UserName" will be considered different.

PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_FILES_UPLOAD_IMAGE: All images that will be uploaded to the system (including as previews for entries) will be compressed by the percentage specified in this field. It is recommended to use no more than 40 percent.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_FILES_AUTO_CONVERT: If automatic conversion of uploaded image is enabled, it will be automatically converted to the selected extension upon upload. For example, if the WEBP extension is selected in the settings, then an uploaded image in JPEG or any other format will be converted to WEBP.
This extension will be used during the upload of any image for its subsequent conversion. Please note that this setting will not be active if automatic image conversion is disabled.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_EMAIL_SMTP_HOST_DE: Address of the SMTP server location. Please note that the value can use both a domain and an IP address.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_EMAIL_SMTP_PORT_DE: Port used by the SMTP server. Please note that typically the following values are often used as protocols: 25 (without encryption), 465 (SSL), and 587 (STARTTLS).
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_EMAIL_SMTP_USERNAM: Username on behalf of which emails will be sent through the SMTP server.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_EMAIL_SMTP_PASSWOR: Password used to connect to the SMTP server by the user.
PAGE_SETTINGS_SETTING_EMAIL_SMTP_DOMAIN_: Domain on behalf of which emails will be sent through the SMTP server. Usually it looks like: no-reply@example.ru
PAGE_SETTINGS_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCRI: CMS settings are parameters and options that allow site administrators to manage various aspects of the functioning and appearance of the website. In the CMS settings, you can set parameters such as site language, security settings, user access rights, SEO optimization, and much more.

CMS settings are important for a website because they allow you to personalize and optimize its operation taking into account the needs and goals of the business. A properly configured CMS helps improve user experience, increase site security, improve SEO indicators, and ensure more efficient content management. Ultimately, this contributes to increased traffic and conversion of the website.
PAGE_FEED_TECHNICAL_NAME_DESCRIPTION: This is the technical name of the feed, which will be used in the URL.
PAGE_FEED_TITLE_DESCRIPTION: Specify a title that would describe the essence of the web feed's content.
PAGE_FEED_DESCRIPTION_DESCRIPTION: Briefly describe the contents of the web feed.
PAGE_FEED_DESCRIPTION_PLACEHOLDER: A compilation of the latest news published in Karelia.
PAGE_FEED_SPECIFICATION_DESCRIPTION: Select the web feed specification on which it will operate.
PAGE_FEED_ENTRIES_CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION: Select the category of entries that will be exported via the web feed.
PAGE_FEED_SIDEBAR_BLOCK_ABOUT_DESCRIPTIO: Feeds are special files containing information about the latest updates on the site, such as new articles, news, comments, etc. Feeds are usually presented in XML or JSON format and can be used for automatic subscription to site updates.

Feeds play an important role for a website because they allow users to stay informed about the latest events without having to constantly visit the site. This is convenient for both visitors and site owners, as it allows increasing traffic and retaining the audience.
Thus, feeds help in convenient and efficient dissemination of information, making the site more attractive and convenient for users.

PAGE_ERROR_400_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the request to "%s" contains a syntax error and the server cannot process it. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_401_DESCRIPTION: Authorization is required to access the requested page. Please sign in and try again. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_403_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, you do not have sufficient permissions to access the requested page. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the site administrator. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_404_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the page you are looking for at "%s" has been deleted or moved. We recommend returning to the home page.
PAGE_ERROR_405_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the HTTP method used is not supported by the server for this address. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_408_DESCRIPTION: The server timed out waiting for your request to complete. Please check your Internet connection and try again. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_410_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the page at "%s" has been permanently removed and will no longer be available. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_413_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the size of the submitted data exceeds the server limit. Please reduce the amount of data and try again. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_414_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the request address "%s" is too long for the server to process. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_429_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, you have sent too many requests in a short period of time. Please wait a moment and try again later. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_451_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, access to the requested page is restricted for legal reasons. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_500_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, an error occurred on the server side that prevents processing your request. We recommend returning to the home page.
PAGE_ERROR_501_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the server does not support the functionality required to process your request. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_502_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the server acting as a gateway or proxy received an invalid response from the upstream server. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_503_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, access to this page is restricted. We recommend returning to the home page.
PAGE_ERROR_504_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, the upstream server did not respond in time. Please try again later. We recommend returning to the main page.
PAGE_ERROR_UNKNOWN_DESCRIPTION: Unfortunately, something went wrong. We recommend returning to the home page.
